review_scope: Integrated current article edits, all 31 main/appendix named statements and the deterministic algorithm, new N2-N4 deductions, proof preservation and notation-to-object consistency. This is an author-side automated self-review, not independent human peer review.

checks.reason: The actual descent ray G(t(-1,16))=-t excludes coercivity/bounded-below status. The cap has genuinely active affine intercept: at (0,t), t>17, its value is t-17, so it is not degree-one homogeneous. No contrary claim about all affine maxima.

If either fixed objective had a finite locally C1,1 polyhedral-cell representation satisfying the positive theorem near its unique minimizer, localization would give one positive value basin. Continuity and the actual bad starts tending to that minimizer put a late bad run in the basin, contradicting its nonoptimal value limit. The inference excludes precisely the theorem hypotheses, not all finite collections of formulas or all convergent singular runs.

All four branch values are zero at zero. Upper scalar slopes vanish; lower residual slopes vanish and the common quadratic has zero gradient. Thus indexed gradients are (0,0,0,e2). The fixed map x=Az sends every covector to A^Tg, giving (0,0,0,A^Te2), with A invertible. Repeated indexed zeros violate affine independence; a strictly positive fourth multiplier gives a nonzero weighted sum. This checks the actual branch representations and preserves the independent lower-case failure of C2 regularity.

Actual differentiable branch gradients of Q_mu are mu*x+g_i. Their subtraction is exactly y=mu*s+(g_j-g_i). On the certified perturbed orbit, convergence implies s->0 and strict activity continues the three distinct slopes; the interpretation is restricted to that actual orbit and does not infer failure from arbitrary switching.

Independent two-branch gradients permit the inverse-function corner curve and common unit level velocity. Strict contours separate supporting normal arcs of distinct corners; smooth cutoffs join positive pairing heights. Angular differentiation of h*n+h_theta*T cancels the normal terms and preserves the one-dimensional tangent. Eligible short-chord transversality gives nonzero determinant; convex chord variation is at most 2d, and d<=Delta/c1 charges transport to objective decrease. The complete unchanged appendix supplies one field and all uniform endpoint estimates; no path-length bound or nonlinear invariance is introduced.

l1/linfinity are actual norm specializations with nonisolated singularities in dimension >=2, not priority claims. Squared loss plus lambda*l1 assumes lambda>0 and a unique minimizer. Sign-stable nonzero optimal coordinates yield affine terms and zero coordinates yield centered absolute values. The resulting local centered representation is exact, convex and C1,1/sublinear as required; the conclusion is local and does not assert uniqueness from lambda>0 or full-rank A.

Current phase value enclosures make every rejected trial visibly increase F. Accepted AWW margins remain in the same exact seed lemma/appendix. Figures explicitly disclose rational-center rendering, unequal drawing scales and schematic shrinking neighborhoods; no drawing or numerical shooting replaces root isolation, stable-manifold membership or all-query induction.

All 31 named statements retain the same normalized content, including accepted differentiability, SPD initialization, fixed constants, arbitrary admissible runs, compactness/locality and both independent negative regularity regimes. The unit-first algorithm is identical after lower/upper bracket aliases. Planar and matrix appendices plus canonical partition statement are byte-identical; seed and lower-curvature appendices are identical after scoped notation (and explicit parentheses around the seed matrix square root). The repeated mixed remainder now has one display and a cross-reference; no indispensable proof was removed.

resolved_findings.resolution: Root changed every indicated scale product to a_ell and synchronized omega; residual-pattern scan and full lower-appendix normalized comparison now pass.

reviewed_exact_formal_declarations.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F ψ : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (a : ι → BfgsVerification.Vec n) (b : ι → ℝ) {U : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
      IsOpen U →

                            (∀ (k : ℕ), R.x k ∈ U) ∧
                              Filter.Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) Filter.atTop (nhds (F star)) ∧
                                Filter.Tendsto R.x Filter.atTop (nhds star)
